chapter.heading: The Consoling Memory of God’s Redemptive WorksTo the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph.
chapter.v:
I cried
out to God with my voice—To God with my voice;And He gave ear to me. [Ezek. 24:6, 9 b]

In the
day of my trouble I sought the Lord;My hand was stretched out in the night without ceasing;My soul refused to be comforted.

I remembered
God, and was troubled;I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed.Selah

You hold
my eyelids open;I am so troubled that I cannot speak. [Is. 8:19]

I have
considered the days of old,The years of ancient times. [Is. 30:13; 47:11; 1 Thess. 5:3] [Is. 25:5 e Job 21:18; Is. 17:13]

I call
to remembrance my song in the night;I meditate within my heart,And my spirit makes diligent search. [Is. 28:2; 30:30 h]

Will the
Lord cast off forever?And will He be favorable no more? [Job 20:8] [Is. 37:36; Mic. 4:11, 12; Zech.]

Has His
mercy ceased forever?Has His promise failed forevermore? [Ps. 73:20]

Has God
forgotten to be gracious?Has He in anger shut up His tender mercies?Selah [Is. 28:7, 8 m Is.]

And I
said, “This is my anguish;But I will remember the years of the right hand of the Most High.” [Ps. 69:23; Is. 6:10 p] [Ps. 69:23; Is. 6:9, 10; Mic. 3:6; Rom. 11:8]

I will
remember the works of the Lord;Surely I will remember Your wonders of old. [Is. 8:16 r Dan. 12:4, 9; [Matt. 13:11-16]; Rev. 5:1-]

I will
also meditate on all Your work,And talk of Your deeds.

Your way,
O God, is in the sanctuary;Who is so great a God as our God? [Col. 2:22] [Ps. 78:36; Ezek. 33:31; Matt. 15:8, 9; Mark 7:6,]

You are
the God who does wonders;You have declared Your strength among the peoples. [Is. 6:9, 10; 28:21; Hab. 1:5 v Is. 44:25; Jer. 49:7; Obad. 8; 1 Cor.]

You have
with Your arm redeemed Your people,The sons of Jacob and Joseph.Selah [Is. 30:1 x Ps. 10:11; 94:7; Is. 47:10; Ezek. 8:12; Mal. 2:17]

The waters
saw You, O God;The waters saw You, they were afraid;The depths also trembled.

The clouds
poured out water;The skies sent out a sound;Your arrows also flashed about. [Is. 32:15]

The voice
of Your thunder was in the whirlwind;The lightnings lit up the world;The earth trembled and shook. [Is. 35:5; Matt. 11:5; Mark 7:37]

Your way
was in the sea,Your path in the great waters,And Your footsteps were not known. [[Ps. 25:9; 37:11; Is. 11:4; 61:1; Matt. 5:5; 11:29] c Is. 14:30; [Matt. 5:3; 11:5; James 2:5]]

You led
Your people like a flockBy the hand of Moses and Aaron. [Is. 28:14 e Is. 59:4; Mic. 2:1]
